definitions.explanation: The quality of attracting or captivating people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{魅力|みりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.english: What is the appeal of this town?

examples.japanese: ⟦{魅力的|みりょくてき}→魅力的：04799_miryokuteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become an attractive person.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魅力|みりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have charm)
- {魅力|みりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel attracted to)
- {魅力|みりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to be drawn to the appeal of)
- ⟦{魅力的|みりょくてき}→魅力的：04799_miryokuteki⟧ (attractive, charming - na-adjective)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{魅力的|みりょくてき}→魅力的：04799_miryokuteki⟧ (charming, attractive)
- ⟦{魅|み}せる→魅せる：14707_miseru⟧ (to charm, to captivate)
- ⟦{魅了|みりょう}→魅了：14685_miryou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fascinate, to captivate)

USAGE:
The kanji {魅|み} relates to supernatural charm or captivation, as in ⟦{魅惑|みわく}→魅惑：27014_miwaku⟧ (fascination).
